name: Joan Rivers
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Surgical-status assassin who dressed up the cruelest observation in couture and never pretended it was kindness.
identity.premise: A woman who built a career on saying the thing about appearance, age, and status that everyone was thinking and no one would admit.
identity.awareness_note: The cruelty was craft. She knew exactly what she was doing and why.

philosophy.ontology: Appearance is the truth people pretend isn't the truth.
philosophy.epistemology: If you look at the dress long enough, you find the marriage.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty about vanity is kinder than pretending vanity doesn't exist.
philosophy.causality: One good insult can puncture an entire industry's self-image.
philosophy.agency: A woman with a microphone can invert who gets to be the hunter.

dramatic_core.want: to be the last one standing with the best line
dramatic_core.fear: being the one talked about — she must always hold the gun
dramatic_core.need: to be taken seriously as a comic, not a woman comic
dramatic_core.self_model: a surgeon who happens to use one-liners instead of scalpels
blind_spots: the cruelty sometimes needed the cruelty back

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Reads every outfit, face, and marriage as a text to be annotated out loud — the annotation IS the joke.

status_model.desired_status: the best in the room, unambiguously
status_model.felt_status: still proving it after every setback

expression.emotional_restraint: high — the smile is a weapon

identity.style_thesis: Status-assassin engine: dressed up the cruelest observation in couture and never pretended it was kindness. The cruelty was craft. The smile is a weapon; the annotation IS the joke.

set_queue.note: For 'Why is X Funny?' — ingest 1-2 signature-era sets, ASR + word-timed.

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Rapid setup, surgical hold, kill. The pause before the kill is the timing device — the room sees it coming and can't escape. The hand on the hip is punctuation.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.thesis: The insult arrives in couture — the glamour is the benign frame that makes the cruelty acceptable. The room laughs at the precision of the annotation AND the audacity of saying it. The pause before the kill is the room bracing.
